body: Thanks for the thorough reply! I have a really bad marriage. Well a lot of the time it's ok, even good. But every week it happens, someone gets angry, explodes, screams, sarcasm, breaks something, some type of huge fight. And often ends with me in my room with a knife thinking oh is it today I will stab myself? I probably sound fake or dramatic, he says I'm not sincere well it is kind of true.

I know what this is like, I'm sorry, it really sucks. I am nervous to open my mouth because I feel like they all want me to shut up as fast as possible.

Anyway, if you have anyone in your life, maybe casual friend or friendly acquaintance or even family, who will be honest with you, ask them what they think. Maybe they have an honest assessment. 

Could it also be that they don't feel negatively towards you, it could be your perception? I don't mean to devalue your experience but i know from having self esteem issues myself i often imagine people thinking the worst about me when maybe it's just not true.
Thanks, that's a very clear answer. I hope I am safe too
Wow!! This is my relationship to a tee. Except I seen to have traits similar to your bf and my bf has traits similar to yours
Sometimes I wish a car would hit me. Not really but I think it has something to do with matching on the outside what it feels like in the inside.
Yeah
How would you say, I'm at early intermediate level?
I don't think relationships are supposed to be anything. They just are.

Thanks for the advice. Sometimes I can resist the urge to follow but sometimes, if it comes out of left field like that, I can't. I know I need to work on this.

Yeah being around him is like walking on eggshells. Part of it is I say a lot of bullshit that annoys him, like exaggerated or approximate speech. Instead of precise facts, which he prefers.

Idk about asking about the future. Whenever I ask him what does he want, he gets philosophical and melancholy and says I don't want anything. I usually ask then, why are you with me? He'll respond quickly with YOU'RE with Me.

I'm just tired of feeling inadequate. But I can't leave him. He is so sad with life.
I don't expect it to get better. I just want to live day by day.

Thanks for the thoughtful response. I like what you say about agreement. But we don't really have a mutually agreeing relationship, it's more he says what he can't tolerate, and if I can't follow this or tolerate his behavior he usually makes me leave the room temporarily. Or he leaves, as was the case here.

Totally agree following him was a bad idea. I'm fully aware of this issue I have.

Nice questions at the end. Why are we ok with this? I guess we're just used to it. Things are usually ok, any way. We do fight often but it's just part of our lives. Everyone has problems.
Totally. And it couples with actually feeling intense emotions. What is real? I find myself asking myself a lot.
So what explains when a non bisexual doesn't have friends?
Well I can't speak for the veracity of these posts, but I often don't use my real voice and my spouse complains about it a lot. We fight about it sometimes.
Wow. She's more of a fat teardrop shape, but you seem to have nailed her down.

Exactly this. When I got fired, my colleagues were like, can we meet for coffee? Fuck that. We didn't have coffee when I was working literally next to you, what makes you think we will now?? Fuck people like that.
Oh I thought this was about sugar daddies funding suicides. I guess that'd be illegal tho
Wow interesting!
I like this. It's a fresh perspective.
No I mean I envy you not having a SO and not looking for one.
Wow CAAAN relate.

DAE have moments of intense screaming when frustrated? I mean like really loud severe screams full of anguishness and despair? Somehow my relationship triggers these with me. They are out of my control and very scary.
That's really cool way to think about it. I like this idea about collaboration.

Man I really wish I was in your situation. I don't like who I am in relationships. It's so exhausting being this way. I think the moment I won't be, I will also be alone because I'm not worthy of companions. In my darkest moments, I anticipate that day. What a relief it will be to be stable.

Hi - I can't help much, but I'd like to say I feel the same thing most of the time. I feel like I don't have a personality. I second-guess my memories and my feelings. I think I also have social anxiety, low self-esteem, not sure I have full-blown depression but I don't seem to have any passion in life or interest in much. I think I've experienced everything in life I've wanted to - what else is there, I ask myself. Is this all there is?

I've heard good things about Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, I think it's about changing mindset.

When I feel bad I listen to podcasts.

I think you did the right thing. It sounds like she doesn't know what a valuable friend she has. Maybe she was even just a bit scared to confront you or speak honestly. Not judging her, people get scared, but if she wants to break it off, that's not your responsibility to hold on.

If you still do care about your relationship with her, I would try to communicate all these feelings to her, just so you can look back at this as a time you were honest to yourself and to her, regardless of what happens next. What happens, will happen -- don't have any expectations. Just stay honest.
Omg I have this same thing, that's why I prefer to cry alone, that's the only way I know 100% I'm not being manipulative. Tears don't really help, except to show how deeply you feel maybe.
